newsitem.title: USA: Calif. flood-control bond measure clears hurdle.
newsitem.headline: Calif. flood-control bond measure clears hurdle.

text.p: A California Senate committee on Tuesday approved a bond measure to finance statewide flood control and prevention programs.
The Senate Committee on Agriculture and Water Resources approved Senate Bill 312 on a vote of 8-to-0. The bill, by Senator Jim Costa, now advances to the appropriations committee.

Costa's bill does not specify the dollar amount of the bond measure, but the senator has proposed a $600 million target. If approved by lawmakers, the bond measure would be placed on the June 1998 statewide ballot.
The bill was introduced in response to flooding in northern and central California in January. The floods caused an estimated $2 billion in losses to public and private property.
